name: year
description: Year of the BLS hierarchical grouping file the row belongs to

name: hierarchy
description: Hierarchical grouping the row belongs to: integrated, interview or diary

name: line_number
description: Position of the row in the BLS grouping file, preserving the published order
observations: Ordinal; continuation lines are merged into the row they continue

name: level
description: Depth of the row in the category tree, 1 being the top

name: title
description: Name of the category, statistic or UCC

name: ucc
description: Universal Classification Code, or the BLS mnemonic for title, group and statistic rows

name: row_type
description: Row type: H header, T title, G group (sum of its children), S statistic, I interview UCC, D diary UCC

name: factor
description: Aggregation factor BLS applies when summing the row into its group

name: section
description: Section of the grouping: CUCHARS, EXPEND, FOOD, INCOME, ASSETS or ADDENDA

name: parent_ucc
description: UCC or mnemonic of the nearest group or title row one level up
